evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: The browser observed a non-empty text event before the persisted terminal time; ordered markers and event sequence were retained.

requirements.title: Cancellation

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: An active task reached persisted cancelled/CANCELLED_UPSTREAM after stop, and the next task completed successfully.

requirements.title: Session recovery
requirements.description: Resume a persisted native session without losing conversation continuity.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: The browser restored the conversation after reload, the same persisted native Session binding was retained, and a harmless two-fact follow-up completed with the expected context.

requirements.title: File artifact
requirements.description: Create, persist, and retrieve a file artifact produced by the Runtime.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: A Runtime-created 46-byte text artifact was persisted, previewed in chat and the file center before and after reload, matched its SHA-256, and was absent from four other Agent workspaces.

requirements.title: Usage reporting
requirements.description: Persist attributable usage evidence for a completed Runtime run.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: A completed Runtime run persisted one non-zero terminal usage snapshot on both the run and assistant message, and the browser displayed its values, source, and unknown-scope limitation before and after reload.

requirements.title: Tool events
requirements.description: Observe tool lifecycle events with stable identifiers and terminal outcomes.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: A real Runtime file-tool lifecycle retained one stable sanitized step identifier from running to completed, persisted ordered event sequences, and remained visible in the browser after reload.

requirements.title: Restart recovery
requirements.description: Recover persisted Runtime state after a controlled process restart.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.note: After a controlled restart of only the test Runtime container, its health recovered, the container identity, native Session binding, and file hash were preserved, and a browser task in the original conversation completed with the expected harmless facts.

requirements.title: Control-plane deployment
requirements.description: Deploy through the supported MyBay product path and pass health checks.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.command: MyBay UI: Agent instance center -> isolated test Agent -> Redeploy -> Confirm
evidence.note: The supported MyBay product path rebuilt only the isolated test Runtime, traversed deploying to running, restored control-plane and Runtime health, reported the chat API ready, and preserved the mounted test artifact byte-for-byte.

requirements.title: Upgrade
requirements.description: Upgrade a deployed Runtime while preserving supported state.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27 upgraded to v2026.8.31; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.command: MyBay UI: Agent version repository -> isolated test Agent -> schedule v2026.8.31 -> server preflight -> confirm upgrade
evidence.note: The supported product path passed preflight with no blockers, replaced the Runtime container, reached completed/success with Runtime and chat readiness healthy, and preserved all observed conversations, messages, runs, native Session bindings, and the mounted artifact hash.

requirements.title: Rollback
requirements.description: Roll back a failed or incompatible upgrade and restore service.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.31 rolled back to v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.command: MyBay UI: Agent version repository -> isolated test Agent -> rollback -> confirm v2026.8.27
evidence.note: The built-in rollback path replaced the upgraded container, restored v2026.8.27, reached rolled_back/success with Runtime and chat readiness healthy, and retained the same supported persisted state and artifact hash.

requirements.title: Security controls
requirements.description: Verify authentication, isolation, secret handling, and privileged capability guards.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.command: Authenticated browser acceptance + anonymous HTTP probes + deployed-container inspection + focused security test suite
evidence.note: Anonymous protected routes returned 401; the authenticated product reported strong admin authentication and encrypted credential storage; Runtime-private files were removed from the file center; and the deployed non-privileged, loopback-bound Agent had only its own data mount, no Docker socket, resource limits, and fail-closed privileged capability policy.

requirements.title: Backup and restore
requirements.description: Restore a supported backup and verify Runtime data through the product path.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes source v2026.8.27 restored to a disposable v2026.8.31 clone; isolated localhost test Agent
evidence.command: MyBay UI: isolated test Agent -> export redacted backup -> import preview -> create stopped clone -> rebind credential and set new password -> initial deployment -> file-center preview -> delete disposable clone
evidence.note: The supported product path exported and validated a redacted backup, restored it to an isolated non-conflicting clone, reached running/chat-ready state after explicit credential reconfiguration, and rendered a byte-identical Runtime output in the browser file center while the source Agent and its persisted state remained unchanged.

requirements.title: Real end-to-end acceptance
requirements.description: Complete a credentialed browser-to-Runtime task on a supported target platform.

evidence.environment: Windows + Docker Desktop; MyBay OSS 0.1.26; Hermes v2026.8.27; isolated localhost test Agent; credentialed DeepSeek model
evidence.command: Authenticated MyBay UI: Agent workspace -> isolated test Agent -> new conversation -> deterministic no-tool task -> observe live stream state and completed result -> reload
evidence.note: A credentialed browser task traversed the supported MyBay product path into Hermes, exposed an active streaming state, persisted ordered text events and a Hermes-owned completed run with terminal usage evidence, returned the exact expected response, and restored the conversation, result, model, and usage after reload.
